answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 54 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes a vault bet on surviving 54 epochs of grading, and every voyage settlement recomputes the karst schedule, so someone who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 16 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 25 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
